description: What the hardening suite must notice in the client manager (lib/mcp/client-manager.mjs) and the task preflight (lib/manager.mjs): launch approval, the pins, the bounded reader, the result ceiling, aborted calls and stderr.

mutations.name: M1-launch-not-checked
mutations.what: a stdio server is spawned without an approved launch record

mutations.name: M2-approval-by-id-only
mutations.what: any approval of the server counts, whatever record it was for

mutations.name: M3-no-executable-hash
mutations.what: the executable's sha256 is not part of the record

mutations.name: M4-env-values-in-record
mutations.what: the record carries env values, not only their names

mutations.name: M5-spawn-the-bare-command
mutations.what: the Hub spawns the command as typed instead of the executable it hashed
mutations.equivalent: With every command the suites use (absolute paths, and a bare name on a PATH holding one match), cross-spawn finds the same file the resolver hashed; the line closes the gap between the two lookups (another PATH order, a second match) that no test here creates.

mutations.name: M6-stale-launch-accepted
mutations.what: approveLaunch pins whatever the record is now, not what the owner was shown

mutations.name: M7-launch-without-fingerprint
mutations.what: approveLaunch takes a call without expectedFingerprint

patches.old: if (typeof expectedFingerprint !== 'string' || !HEX64.test(expectedFingerprint)) throw fault('mcp_fingerprint_required', 'An approval names the fingerprint of the launch record
patches.new: if (false) throw fault('mcp_fingerprint_required', 'An approval names the fingerprint of the launch record

mutations.name: M8-tools-without-fingerprint
mutations.what: approveTools takes a call without expectedFingerprint

patches.old: if (typeof expectedFingerprint !== 'string' || !HEX64.test(expectedFingerprint)) throw fault('mcp_fingerprint_required', 'An approval names the fingerprint of the lists
patches.new: if (false) throw fault('mcp_fingerprint_required', 'An approval names the fingerprint of the lists

mutations.name: M9-pin-with-wrong-key
mutations.what: approveTools hands the pin store {fingerprint}, which it ignores

patches.old: const answer = await this.pins.approve(serverId, connection.snapshot, { expectedFingerprint });
patches.new: const answer = await this.pins.approve(serverId, connection.snapshot, { fingerprint: expectedFingerprint });

mutations.name: M10-usable-without-pin
mutations.what: a connected server's tools are callable and offered without a pin

mutations.name: M11-no-pin-check
mutations.what: the lists are never checked against the pin

patches.new: const check = { ok: true, state: 'pinned', fingerprint: 'f'.repeat(64) };

mutations.name: M12-catalog-without-pin
mutations.what: catalogGroups offers every connected server

mutations.name: M13-reader-no-ceiling
mutations.what: a message that grows over several chunks is read without a limit

mutations.name: M14-reader-no-ceiling-one-chunk
mutations.what: a message that arrives in one chunk with its newline is read without a limit

mutations.name: M15-result-not-limited
mutations.what: a tool result reaches the caller unbounded

mutations.name: M16-abort-not-unknown
mutations.what: a caller abort after the request was sent is reported as the plain abort reason

patches.old: if (signal?.aborted) throw fault('mcp_call_aborted', `The call to the MCP tool
patches.new: if (signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason; if (false) throw fault('mcp_call_aborted', `The call to the MCP tool

mutations.name: M17-no-early-abort-check
mutations.what: a signal that is already aborted is not refused before the request is sent

mutations.name: M18-stderr-not-collected
mutations.what: the server's stderr is not kept by the bounded collector

mutations.name: M19-too-large-call-unnamed
mutations.what: a call cut by the read limit is reported as an ordinary lost connection

mutations.name: M20-too-large-status-unnamed
mutations.what: status() says connection lost when the read limit closed it

mutations.name: M21-too-large-connect-unnamed
mutations.what: a connect cut by the read limit is reported as mcp_connect_failed

mutations.name: M22-pathext-ignored
mutations.what: a bare command is looked up without PATHEXT

patches.old: return ext && extensions.some((known) => known.toLowerCase() === ext) ? [base] : extensions.map((known) => base + known);

mutations.name: M23-path-ignored
mutations.what: a bare command is not looked up on the server's PATH

mutations.name: M24-no-preflight
mutations.what: the task preflight does not connect the approved servers

mutations.name: M25-preflight-no-relist
mutations.what: the preflight does not list a connected server again (a rug pull since the last task is missed)

patches.old: if (connection?.state === 'connected') await this.#refreshLists(connection, { signal, timeout: connection.timeouts.connectMs });
